steps.caption: Cloudflare
steps.narration: This is Cloudflare. It shows each site's traffic and firewall events, and adds rules you review first.

steps.caption: Connected sites
steps.narration: Every connected site is listed. New zones are found every hour; a site's analytics refresh when you choose Sync.

steps.caption: Open a site
steps.narration: Open a site to see its last day of traffic.

steps.caption: Requests, threats, page views, bots
steps.narration: The tiles add up requests, threats and page views, and the share of scored requests that were bots.

steps.caption: Pin a day
steps.narration: Click a bar in the trend, and that day's date and request count show above it.

steps.caption: Latest firewall events
steps.narration: Further down are the latest firewall events: the action, the IP address, the country and the path.

steps.selector: section:has(> div > [role="search"] > input[aria-label="Search Events"]) th button:has-text("Country")
steps.caption: Sort any column
steps.narration: Click a column, like Country, to sort all the rows.

steps.caption: Flagged IPs
steps.narration: Flagged IPs lists the addresses Click Guard blocked for this domain.

steps.caption: Add to preview
steps.narration: Choose Add to preview, and the address goes into the Flagged IPs rule pack.

steps.caption: Three rule packs
steps.narration: The other packs guard your ads landing page, or block bad user agents across the site.

steps.caption: Preview rules
steps.narration: Choose Preview rules. Nothing is sent to Cloudflare yet.

steps.caption: The zone, a warning, the exact rule
steps.narration: The preview shows the zone, a warning, and the exact rule expression it would add.

steps.caption: Nothing changes until you confirm
steps.narration: Rules are queued for Cloudflare only when you confirm. Each change is kept in the Edge audit, ready to undo.

steps.caption: Menu: Cloudflare
steps.narration: You'll find Cloudflare in the menu on the left, under Tools.

youtube.title: Cloudflare in about a minute | ConstructHUB
youtube.description: A one-minute tour of Cloudflare in ConstructHUB: every connected site in one list, each site's traffic, threats and firewall events, and protection rules you preview before anything is queued for Cloudflare.
